title: Modernize Design
content: Transform to a modern aesthetic with clean lines and minimal visual noise. Use subtle box shadows (shadow-sm to shadow-md) for depth, implement contemporary sans-serif typography with proper hierarchy (text-sm to text-4xl). Apply generous whitespace using consistent spacing scale (p-4, p-6, p-8, gap-4, gap-6). Use a neutral color palette (gray-50 to gray-900) with one accent color. Add smooth transitions (duration-200) for interactive elements. Ensure proper visual hierarchy with size, weight, and color variations.

variants.simple: Update the design to look modern with clean lines, subtle shadows, and good spacing.

variants.advanced: Transform to a modern aesthetic with clean lines and minimal visual noise. Use subtle box shadows (shadow-sm to shadow-md) for depth with GPU-accelerated transforms. Implement contemporary sans-serif typography with proper hierarchy (text-sm to text-4xl) and fluid typography using clamp() for responsive scaling. Apply generous whitespace using consistent 4px/8px spacing scale (p-4, p-6, p-8, gap-4, gap-6). Use a neutral color palette (gray-50 to gray-900) with one accent color meeting WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios. Add smooth transitions (duration-200) with ease-out timing for interactive elements. Implement focus-visible states for keyboard navigation. Use CSS custom properties for theming consistency. Add prefers-reduced-motion support. Ensure proper visual hierarchy with size, weight, and color variations. Include skeleton loading states for async content.
